title: The Exodus and the Landing
text: About 190 years ago the anti-imperial houses of Assios fled south: fifteen years of desperate crossings, guarded by the companies that became the Hunters.

title: The Great Slave Rebellion
text: About 60 EC: the enslaved of the young federation rose, and slavery was abolished in Council lands.

title: The Plague of the Burning Sea
text: About 90 EC: a great maritime pestilence that swept the archipelago and scarred a generation.

title: The Breakwater
text: 91 EC: the one time the Armada and the Hunters fought each other in earnest. It gave the islands the Breakwater Protocols and the yearly Wargames.

title: The Ascendant's War
text: 105 EC: the Archmage Eldric Morvane raised a Krysta-bound mage-army and nearly took the Heartland. Out of it came the Arcane Registry.

title: The Southern Quarantine
text: 148 EC: a fever killed the colony of Fairhope and a Charter survey squadron in the far south, and the Council sealed those waters.

title: The Battle of the Kraken's Maw
text: 165 EC, sixteen hours: the Coalition of the Navy and the Hunters broke Admiral Blackheart's pirate armada.
